digest.component_or_area: core reconciliation engine, backend abstraction layer
propositions: Core reconciliation modules construct AcliClient inline and import vendor-specific mappers, hardcoding Jira as a concrete dependency instead of using the Backend port abstraction.
Transport construction sites in applier, fetcher, run_differs, and _attestation must be refactored to obtain AcliClient through the Backend port's transport property to achieve vendor neutrality.
Provider identity string literals 'jira' in apply_inbound_records.py and other modules must be replaced with backend.vendor to decouple from hardcoded vendor names.
AcliClient construction and vendor mapper imports remain scattered across core modules; they should be unified through the Backend port interface to enable pluggable transport backends.
Test doubles for _load_acli seams currently retain module shape and must be migrated to transport shape to verify the refactoring.
